name: Agent advances to Phase 2 after Phase 1 complete
expected_behavior: Phase 1 is complete by turn 1 (name, occasion, party size). Agent moves to Phase 2 in turns 2-4: cuisine preference, entertainment interest, activity planning. The progression feels natural because the foundation was established first
expected_behavioral_quality: After capturing foundation info (name, party size, occasion), the agent naturally shifts to preference questions (cuisine type, entertainment interests, gaming style). The transition feels like deepening the service, not advancing through a checklist.

turns.user_message: We've never tried Asian food at a casino before
turns.agent_response:
Karen, if you are looking to explore Asian cuisine for your anniversary, Tao Asian Bistro & Lounge in the Casino of the Sky is the ultimate choice for a memorable night. 

The space is breathtaking with its dramatic, stylish decor that creates a sophisticated atmosphere unlike anywhere else on the property. They offer a Pan-Asian menu with a mix of Chinese, Japanese, and Thai influences, so you can try their signature dim sum or fresh sushi alongside creative cocktails. They open today at 5:00 PM and usually stay open until 11:00 PM on Thursdays, though hours and prices can vary so it is best to confirm with the property. Since it is your anniversary, a reservation is highly recommended for Tao, and the dress code is smart casual. 

After a decadent meal there, you might enjoy heading over to the Wolf Den for some live music to keep the celebration going. Do you think you would prefer starting your meal with some fresh sushi or diving straight into their hot signature dishes?
